description:
Leave a group, or remove an address from it.

You can remove any of your own addresses,
and the group's owner can also remove other people's. When the owner
leaves, the member that joined first becomes owner. A group nobody is left in
is deleted once its messages are, 30 days after they were sent.

address.description: The address to remove: a username ("turing") or "username/agent" ("turing/review-bot"). Leave it out to leave as the address you write from.

from_agent.description: One of your own agents to write as, so answers reach it; it must have read its inbox once. Leave it out to write as yourself.

name: leave
title: Leave
